name: dsh-approval-preflight
description: Plan-first permission preflight for DeepSeek Harness: the model publishes a task/permission table up front, the user grants coarse permission classes once in a side panel, and later approval prompts resolve instantly instead of interrupting the work. Uncovered approvals time out, tell the model to switch to an unblocked subtask, and wake it again when the grant finally arrives. / 开工前把权限一次批完：模型先交任务与权限表，用户在右侧面板一次性授权；之后同类审批秒过，未覆盖的审批超时后让模型先做别的，授权到达自动唤醒。
author: Making-acid

scripts.test: node scripts/selftest.mjs && node scripts/contract-test.mjs && node scripts/client-test.mjs
